agnt session list — the two views

Tab switches between them. Both are built and running against the real CLIs.

Status answers "what needs me now". Repository answers "what was I doing in reed".

Where the build departed from these drawings:

· repositories sort by what is in them, not by name
· no per-repository collapse yet — history sinks to the bottom instead
· no quoted last message until a transcript source exists
